evaluation_target.rationale: The safety goal explicitly requires preventing omission of required braking maneuvers, and the hazard/functional requirements describe braking as the action needed to avoid collision in the stated operational situation.

phenomenon_of_interest.statement: Whether the vehicle executes a braking maneuver when braking is required to avoid a collision with an obstacle or road user in the declared operational situation.
phenomenon_of_interest.scope: Straight-ahead driving on a less frequented single-lane road at 50 km/h in good weather, including the hazardous situation where a pedestrian runs across the street 20 m in front of the ego vehicle and the system must decide and perform braking to avoid collision with a road user or static obstacle.
phenomenon_of_interest.rationale: The concern is about omitted braking in a concrete hazardous operational situation; the phenomenon to characterise is the occurrence or non-occurrence of the needed braking action in that situation.

distinctions.dimension: Braking decision outcome in the hazardous situation
distinctions.contrast_b: Required braking maneuver is not initiated / is omitted
distinctions.rationale: Collapsing these cases would remove the very information needed to evaluate whether the safety goal is satisfied, because the concern is specifically omission of braking when required.

distinctions.dimension: Collision-avoidance relevance of the detected obstacle/road user
distinctions.contrast_a: Obstacle or road user is present in a way that requires braking to avoid collision
distinctions.contrast_b: No such braking-relevant obstacle/road user is present
distinctions.rationale: The braking obligation depends on whether a collision-relevant obstacle or road user exists; if these cases were indistinguishable, one could not tell when braking is required.

orrs.obligation: An admissible Observable Representation shall preserve whether a required braking maneuver occurs or is omitted in the hazardous operational situation.
orrs.distinguishability_criterion: The representation must distinguish braking-initiated/performed cases from braking-omitted/non-initiated cases for the same operational situation.

orrs.obligation: An admissible Observable Representation shall preserve whether the operational situation contains a collision-relevant obstacle or road user that makes braking required.
orrs.distinguishability_criterion: The representation must distinguish the presence of a braking-relevant obstacle or road user from its absence within the declared operational scope.
